title: Run during the first leftward reset sweep
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic machine, $A$ a nondeterministic machine, and $x$ a Boolean input word; let $m\in\mathbb N$, choose an input-head position and work-tape contents and head positions for both machines, and let $w$ be a Boolean choice word of length at most $m$. If the yard-tape head starts at $z=|w|-1$, then running the host machine from phase $p0$ under $w$ leaves it in phase $p0$, with input-head position given by $|w|$ clamped left moves from its starting position, each of $A$’s work-tape heads advanced by $|w|$, the yard-tape head at $-1$, and the other listed tape data and output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a deterministic machine over Boolean symbols
$A$ is a nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols
$sT$ and $aT$ specify Boolean work-tape contents for $S$ and $A$
$sP$ and $aP$ specify integer work-tape head positions for $S$ and $A$
$w$ is a Boolean word with length at most $m$
